title: Quieter music discs
description: Amplifies the sound of all music discs by -10 dB
body: All music disc sounds have been ripped from the game and are amplified in Audacity by -10 dB, thus quieting the sound of the music discs since I find them way too loud. Reducing the sound in the options also quiets the sound of noteblocks which I find undesirable, thus I made this resourcepack.
